text:
marta: Quick thread to finalize the Meridian POC handoff. Need agreement on success criteria, data ingress, SQ redaction, and a temporary burst plan. Proposed POC length: 2 weeks (ingest + 4k eval prompts).

devon: Suggest pass/fail: 1) p95 < 350ms for 256-token prompts, 2) macro relevance >= 80% on stratified eval buckets, 3) zero PII in outputs as measured by automated redactor. We can provide scoring harness.

olivia-cust: Sounds good. We'll provide a CSV with id,prompt,expected_answer,category. Prefer to use our S3; security prefers no cross-account roles if possible.

ops: Two supported ingest flows: (A) cross-account read-only role scoped to a prefix, or (B) presigned PUT to a temporary bucket. Presigned is simplest for customers who want to avoid IAM changes. Note: private peering/VPC egress adds time.

marta: Customer called out SQ-3412 asking that sensitive fields be redacted before transfer. Can we give a recommended redaction snippet and a checklist for their security team?

devon: Here's a tiny conservative client-side redactor:
```python
import re

def redact(s):
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\\b\\d{12,19}\\b", "[REDACTED_NUM]", s)
    return s
```
Run over CSV prior to upload. We'll note it's not exhaustive and recommend customer review.

olivia-cust: We'll run redaction and hold back a blind test set (20%). Plan to deliver 3.5k rows total with categories.

ops: For scoring: fuzzy token overlap >=0.8 plus exact-match for structured fields. We'll supply a small scoring script and a smoke test harness.

marta: Pricing Q: they want a burst window for load testing. For a short POC we can provide a temporary reserved node with a capped spend. Sales: can we offer a $400 setup + $120/day reserved discount + per-token overage?
devon: That looks fine. I'll draft SOW language with spend cap and alerts.

sec-bot: Ticket SQ-3412-response created (TICKET-6120). Assigned to security@redwood. ETA first-pass: 48h.

olivia-cust: Timeline: we'll send sanitized CSV Tue EOD, Redwood to ingest Wed, run smoke Thu, and deliver POC report next Tue. Any blockers?

marta: Action items:
- @olivia-cust: upload sanitized CSV to presigned link when ready
- @devon: share redaction snippet + scoring harness by EOD
- @ops: provide presigned flow details and IP allowlist if needed
- @marta: draft SOW with spend cap and circulate
Meeting to confirm ingest Wed 11am PT. :white_check_mark:

devon: I'll also include 5 sample prompts and expected outputs for local validation before ingest.

olivia-cust: Thanks everyone, will push files Tue.

marta: Great, thanks. If security insists on no presigned uploads we'll pivot to cross-account role and adjust timeline.
